name: studyreel
description: StudyReel - a study-gated streaming platform where IT coursework unlocks timed movie access.

scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
scripts.vercel-build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace server run migrate && npm --workspace server run seed && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
